start.welcome: Ciao! 👋 I'm Kartino — your Italian flashcard buddy. I help the words you learn stay with you, effortlessly. 🌱 ✏️ Send me any Italian word or phrase 🤖 I'll craft a fresh explanation every time — no two cards are the same! ✨ 💾 Save the ones you like — I'll bring them back for review using spaced repetition, right when you need a refresh. 🔔 Small heads-up: review your cards when they arrive — new ones won't come until you do! 💡 Type /help to discover everything I can do. Ready? Drop me your first word!

help.message: 📖 What can I do? ✏️ Learn a word — Just send me any Italian word or phrase and I'll explain it with a fresh, AI-crafted card. 📅 /get — Review a saved card (or wait — I'll send them automatically!) 📦 /import — Bulk add a list of words at once. 🔄 /verb andare — Look up verb conjugations instantly. 📖 /story — I'll write a short story using your saved words. 📇 /list_my_flashcards — Browse your full deck. ⚙️ /settings — Make Kartino yours! Set your language, level, review pace & more. 💬 /feedback — Tell me what you think!
help.reply: 💡 Quick start: just type an Italian word right here and let's go!

verb.instruction:
✋ Small tip!

To get the conjugation of a verb, type:
/verb <the verb you want>

For example:
/verb andare

💡 In the command menu, if you press and hold the /verb command, it will be added to your message box — then you can simply type the verb after it.

Please try again later or try another verb.

import.usage_guide:
Got a list? Let's add them all! 📦

Just type `/import` followed by your words (on new lines or separated by commas):

Example:
/import
andare a casa
fare colazione
